name: Vistalyra
summary:
Watch your videos from a seat, a sofa or lying back. Vistalyra is a VR video player for local files and supported direct media streams. Buy once: every feature is included, with no ads or subscription.

Play 2D movies, 3D side-by-side and over-under videos, VR180, VR360 and equidistant fisheye. Choose flat or curved cinema, full or half stereo, swap eyes or watch one eye in 2D.
